continuation_gate: For each dataset, seed-mean block loss <=0.995 times seed-mean best baseline (best chosen separately per seed from F0, lora, split, center, anchor, pooled, blend, calibration); each seed block/F0 <=1.01; seed-mean absolute 80% coverage error <= strongest baseline error +0.01; selected block step>0 and nonzero shape displacement in every dataset/seed. Otherwise STOP. This is a research continuation gate, not publication PASS.
evaluation_scope: Later chronological periods not scored in previous repository runs; same source series, potential foundation pretraining overlap, only two datasets. New holdout within this pilot, not external replication.
stop: One preregistered 48-fit pilot, 5760 proposed training iterations. No recipe expansion or post-E method tuning in this run.
